externalFacts.failureRule: provider unavailable or corrupted fact fails the entire KPI request

queryContract.visibleProjectInput: non-empty trusted ACTION_VIEW project id set; empty set short-circuits to all-zero
queryContract.candidateQuery: CUT-owned scenario Query objects and Mapper XML for joins or dynamic collections

consistency.response: all four counts are returned together from committed CUT facts

legacy.statusMetrics: count only current CUT rows that already satisfy the exact current predicates; never infer from legacy tinyint or text

hardDependencies: F-CUT-002 through F-CUT-006 current CUT facts and action guards
